subject: Triple-cloud MAP and final billing path for NovaMed private-offer
messages:
From: Sanjay Rao <sanjay.rao@novamed.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@novamed.com
Date: Thu, 30 May 2029 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Next steps — private-offer MAP for multi-cloud commit

Irene — thanks for the call this morning. Procurement asked me to capture a concrete MAP (milestones, owners, and billing path) that covers AWS, GCP, and Azure private offers so our finance team can approve the purchase. Our priorities: predictable invoicing (single point of billing preferred), an acceptance window for technical validation, and a clear PO/invoice route.

Can you share a one-page MAP and the final invoice instructions so we can route to AP this week? Also attaching our standard vendor onboarding checklist (see attachment).

Thanks,
Sanjay Rao
Director, IT Procurement
NovaMed Health
[attachment: NovaMed_Onboard_Checklist.xlsx (xlsx)]

From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
To: Sanjay Rao <sanjay.rao@novamed.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 30 May 2029 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Next steps — private-offer MAP for multi-cloud commit

Hi Sanjay — attaching an initial MAP and the draft SOW for your review. High-level summary below — I kept it compact for AP.

Key milestones (proposed):
- Week 0 (today): Mutual Action Plan (MAP) & SOW shared — owners named
- Week 1: Technical validation kickoff (test workloads) — NovaMed + Redwood infra eng
- Week 2–3: Acceptance period (scoped perf tests + security checklist)
- Week 4: Sign-off & issue PO to Redwood (private-offer activation on chosen cloud(s))
- Week 5: Invoice issue and payment window (Net 30), billing flow confirmed to AP

Billing path options we propose (pick one):
1) Consolidated invoicing: Redwood issues a single monthly invoice and itemizes cloud SKUs per cloud region (preferred for NovaMed finance).
2) Cloud-mediated invoicing: Each cloud (AWS/GCP/Azure) issues its own invoice via marketplace private-offer; Redwood provides reconciliations and one summary invoice.

I've flagged option 1 as recommended for predictable cash ops. See MAP_v1_NovaMed.xlsx and SOW-draft-v3.pdf. Jordan — can you confirm the consolidated invoicing flow (billing ownership, tax paperwork) and whether Finance needs an additional PO header?

Best,
Irene Choi
Sr. Manager, Customer Success — Redwood Inference
[attachment: MAP_v1_NovaMed.xlsx (xlsx)] [attachment: SOW-draft-v3.pdf (pdf)]

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 30 May 2029 11:21:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Next steps — private-offer MAP for multi-cloud commit

Looping in Finance Ops (Grace) and Legal (Kimberly) for two quick confirmations:

- Finance: consolidated invoicing (option 1) is doable but we need NovaMed's tax ID and preferred remit address. If NovaMed insists on cloud-mediated invoicing, we'll provide reconciliations and a monthly summary.
- Legal: SOW comment window — Kimberly, any material terms that would delay the PO by >1 week?

Grace — I added a short invoice template (invoice_instructions.txt) to MAP_v1. If AP can return the vendor header today we can lock Week 4 as PO date.

Thanks — Jordan
Head of Commercial Ops, Redwood Inference

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Sanjay Rao <sanjay.rao@novamed.com>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 31 May 2029 08:46:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Next steps — private-offer MAP for multi-cloud commit

Sanjay — quick legal check: the SOW draft is standard for private-offer engagement. Two minor asks that won't hold the PO:
- Insert customer-approved data residency clause (I'll attach a single-paragraph addendum once you confirm preferred region).
- Confirm whether NovaMed requires a PO milestone tied to acceptance (we usually accept sign-off via email).

If either item is required, please reply with the exact language or PO milestone; otherwise we can proceed with the attached SOW and the MAP as-is.

—Kimberly Park
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
[attachment: redwood_sow_commentset.diff (txt)]

From: Sanjay Rao <sanjay.rao@novamed.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, procurement@novamed.com
Date: Fri, 31 May 2029 15:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Next steps — private-offer MAP for multi-cloud commit

Thanks — we reviewed internally and will proceed with option 1 (consolidated invoicing). A couple of final items:
- NovaMed remit and vendor header: NovaMed Health, TAXID 12-3456789, Remit: AP Dept, 123 Healthway Dr., Suite 200, Boston, MA 02110
- Acceptance milestone: we will require a one-week acceptance sign-off after the perf tests (email confirmation ok) before the PO is issued.

We will route the PO to Redwood next Monday. Please send the final MAP and SOW with the single-paragraph data residency addendum (GCP us-central1 preferred) and confirm the DocuSign link for signatures.

Sanjay Rao
Director, IT Procurement
NovaMed Health
[attachment: NovaMed_PO_Header.pdf (pdf)]
